d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The HSE Engineer is responsible for implementing, monitoring, and maintaining Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) standards across project construction activities, ensuring compliance with company policies, client requirements, and applicable regulations.
q: Bachelor's degree or Diploma in HSE, Engineering, or a related discipline.
NEBOSH Certificate or equivalent HSE qualification.
Minimum 7 years of relevant HSE experience, preferably within construction or EPC projects.
Previous exposure to Wind, Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and/or substation construction safety.
Good knowledge of construction safety regulations, risk assessments, and HSE management systems.
Strong communication, reporting, and site coordination skills.

r: Implement and monitor project HSE plans, procedures, and safety requirements.
Conduct regular site inspections, safety audits, and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards.
Ensure safe execution of construction activities, including Wind, Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and/or substation projects.
Monitor compliance with HSE legislation, industry standards, and client requirements.
Conduct toolbox talks, safety inductions, and HSE awareness training for project personnel and contractors.
Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, recommending corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor contractor HSE performance and ensure implementation of appropriate safety controls.
Maintain HSE records, reports, inspection findings, and incident documentation.
Promote a proactive safety culture and continuous improvement across project activities.

d: Join a fast-paced vehicle testing team supporting innovative automotive and mapping technology operations across major markets in the Middle East.

The Project Coordinator – Vehicle Testing Operations will serve as the primary operational point of contact between the client, Drivers, and internal project management team. This role is responsible for coordinating daily testing activities, conducting driver orientations and operational training, managing route assignments, monitoring driving progress, and ensuring that all testing activities are executed according to client requirements and established operational procedures.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and confident in managing client relationships and field operations. This position requires strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and monitoring skills, with the ability to manage multiple Drivers and ensure smooth execution of daily vehicle testing activities.
Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day client coordination and operational concerns.
Attend client meetings, project briefings, and operational updates.
Communicate project requirements, operational updates, and performance expectations to Drivers.
Address client inquiries, escalate operational concerns, and ensure timely resolution of issues.
Maintain strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
Conduct Driver onboarding, orientation, and operational training before deployment.
Ensure Drivers understand assigned routes, driving schedules, testing procedures, safety protocols, and reporting requirements.
Provide regular coaching and guidance to ensure compliance with client expectations.
Monitor Driver attendance, punctuality, performance, and adherence to assigned schedules.
Coordinate Driver deployment, shift schedules, replacements, and daily manpower requirements.
Prepare and distribute daily route assignments and driving schedules to Drivers.
Monitor Driver progress and route completion throughout assigned shifts.
Ensure Drivers strictly follow designated routes and testing instructions, with no unauthorized detours or deviations.
Track daily driving distance, driving hours, route coverage, and task completion.
Coordinate route adjustments and reassignment when operationally necessary and authorized.
Identify route execution issues, delays, and deviations, and implement appropriate corrective actions.
Ensure accurate recording and reporting of completed routes and assigned driving activities.
Oversee daily vehicle testing operations to ensure activities run smoothly and according to project timelines.
Coordinate with Drivers, clients, and relevant operational teams to address day-to-day requirements.
Monitor vehicle availability, deployment schedules, and operational readiness.
Ensure completion and submission of daily operational reports, route logs, attendance records, and other required documentation.
Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
Escalate incidents, safety concerns, vehicle issues, and other critical operational matters promptly.
Support project planning, resource allocation, and operational performance tracking.
Ensure Drivers comply with traffic regulations, company policies, client requirements, and established safety procedures.
Monitor compliance with assigned driving hours, rest periods, and operational schedules.
Ensure all Drivers complete required safety briefings and operational training.
Review daily reports and ensure accurate documentation of route completion, incidents, and irregularities.
Prepare and present regular operational updates and performance reports to the client and management.
Maintain confidentiality of client information, vehicle testing activities, and project-related data.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Project Coordination, Operations Management, Logistics, Fleet Management, or a similar role.
Experience in client-facing roles, with the ability to communicate professionally and manage client expectations.
Experience coordinating field personnel, drivers, or operational teams.
Strong proficiency in GPS navigation, digital mapping applications, and route monitoring tools.
Proficient in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Excellent organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English & Arabic..
Willingness to work flexible schedules, including evenings, overnight shifts, and weekends, depending on project requirements.
Willingness to travel or be deployed within Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates, as required.
Experience in automotive, vehicle testing, mapping, navigation, or geospatial projects.
Experience managing Drivers or field operations teams across multiple locations.
Familiarity with GPS tracking systems, route optimization tools, and real-time fleet monitoring platforms.
Experience conducting training sessions, onboarding, and operational briefings.
Previous experience working with international clients or multinational project teams.
Knowledge of fleet operations, vehicle safety, and road regulations within the Middle East.
Experience preparing operational dashboards, KPIs, and client performance reports.

d: The CVM & Retention Expert is responsible for executing customer value management and retention initiatives that enhance customer engagement, strengthen loyalty, maximize customer value, and minimize churn. The role supports the development and execution of targeted campaigns, customer lifecycle activities, retention programs, and personalized offers by analyzing customer data and behavior. Working closely with the Products & Services, Customer Experience, Sales, Digital, and Customer Care teams, the role ensures effective execution of CVM initiatives while continuously monitoring campaign performance and identifying opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and revenue growth.
Develop and implement customer base management activities across all customer segments to enhance revenue, improve retention, and reduce churn.
Execute the CVM plan and support the achievement of revenue targets from the existing customer base.
Analyze customer data, usage patterns, and behavior to identify customer value enhancement opportunities.
Support customer segmentation activities to enable targeted retention, upselling, and cross-selling initiatives.
Monitor customer churn trends and recommend proactive retention actions.
Design, implement, execute, and monitor BTL campaigns across multiple channels, including digital channels.
Develop and maintain dashboards to monitor campaign performance and effectiveness.
Support the development and execution of churn management activities, including proactive and reactive retention initiatives.
Work closely with the Customer Experience and Digital teams to support customer journey improvements.
Gather and analyze customer feedback to identify opportunities to improve customer experience and loyalty.
Implement personalized communication activities for different customer segments.
Support contract renewal and customer locking initiatives.
Work closely with Sales, Tele-sales, and Customer Care teams to execute upselling, cross-selling, and retention initiatives.
Support sales channels through incentives, push activities, and training to ensure successful execution of the CVM plan.
Ensure CVM activities complement overall marketing launches and go-to-market initiatives.
Prepare campaign performance reports and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Bachelor’s degree in law, economics, engineering or business equivalent.
8–10 years of experience in Telecom or a related industry with exposure to Customer Value Management, customer retention, or customer lifecycle management.
Experience in executing customer retention campaigns, customer segmentation activities, and personalized marketing initiatives.
Experience working with cross-functional teams to deliver customer engagement and revenue enhancement initiatives.
In-depth knowledge of telecom CVM practices, customer segmentation, churn management, and retention strategies.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer data and generate actionable insights.
Knowledge of campaign management tools, CMS platforms, and BI/Analytics tools.
Understanding of sales channel dynamics and customer targeting practices.
Knowledge of marketing planning, proposition management, and operating plans.
Ability to develop commercial business cases.
Strong communication, presentation, reporting, and negotiation skills.
